Help the Bombardier! I'm the Bombardier! is a quest achievement earned for killing ten Schnottz infantry with one artillery shell during the Fire From the Sky (daily) daily quest in Uldum. Despite the description, it is much easier to to take a Multiple Rounds Simultaneous Impact-like approach by firing one shell way, way off in the distance and firing another shell closer to the viewpoint, timing it such that the shells land at the same time. It is also possible to earn this achievement during the initial Fire From the Sky (quest) quest offered by Harrison.

The Herb Garden is available to players at level 96. After completing Clearing the Garden the herb garden will unlock and be given to you for free. __NOTOC__ Herezegor Flametusk is an orc of the Dragonmaw clan. He is known for having commanded legions of Dragonmaw warriors. He appears at The Wyvern's Tail within the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar. The Horde asked Herezegor for a map into the Twilight Highlands. During the conversation, he was attacked by Twilight assassins which he and adventurers killed. Due to the attack and his thoughts on restoring the Dragonmaw clan to greatness, he agreed to create the map. Herezegor was present at the first Azerothian Kosh'harg in Razor Hill in Durotar. He was skeptical at Thrall's invitation for the Dragonmaws to the festival due to the clan's history. He was accompanied by Grot Deathblow.

Heretics or apostates are those believing in or practicing religious heresy, holding beliefs and opinions at odds with that of their former religion or group, and therefore opposed to a set of doctrines and teachings. In fact, heresy is any belief, practice, blasphemy, act, or theory that is strongly at variance with established beliefs, traditions, or customs in a society, in particular the accepted beliefs of a religious organization. Present among all the races, cults, and societies, those accused of being heretics by their actions and beliefs are denigrated or treated as pariahs by their people, and subsequently rejected, exiled, or eliminated. Heroes of the Storm, often shortened to Heroes or HotS (even though "HotS" can also refer to a StarCraft II expansion), is a Blizzard Entertainment "hero brawler" game which was initially inspired by the Defense of the Ancients custom map for Warcraft III. The game features characters from across the Warcraft, StarCraft, The Lost Vikings, Diablo and Overwatch franchises, who are seized by an unknown force and brought together in a mysterious location known as the Nexus to do battle. On 13 December 2018, Blizzard decided to pull some developers to other projects and announce that the Heroes Global Championship and Heroes of the Dorm will not return in 2019. Hero of Warspear was a Player vs. Player achievement earned from gaining status with Vol'jin's Spear.
Heroic: Assault on Violet Hold is an achievement earned from defeating either Sael'orn or Fel Lord Betrug in the Assault on Violet Hold on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Here We Go Again was an achievement earned by reaching Honor Prestige Level 2.
__NOTOC__ Herbalist Tharillon is a nightborne located in Suramar.
The Herblore of the Ancients is a book found in a burial chamber (last one on the left) in Haustvald, Stormheim, in which Runeskeld Rollo also resides.

Heritage armor sets are cosmetic rewards unique to each playable race. Their cosmetic nature means they are transmoggable over any armor type, from plate to cloth. The set is unlocked account-wide, and can be worn or transmogrified by any character of the armor's race.
Heretic Crystal Guards are naga located in Ethel Rethor in Desolace during the Midsummer Fire Festival.
The Heritage of the Shal'dorei is the heritage armor set for the Nightborne allied race.
The Heritage of the Ren'dorei is the heritage armor set for the void elf allied race.
Hermf is a goblin located in the Valley of Spirits in Orgrimmar.

Heritage of the Dark Iron is a reputation achievement earned for leveling a Dark Iron dwarf character to 50 without the use of Recruit-A-Friend level grants or the Character Boost, Race Change, or Faction Change services.
Heritage of the Mag'har is a reputation achievement earned for leveling a newly created Mag'har orc to level 50.
Heroic: Atal'Dazar is a dungeon achievement earned for defeating Yazma in Atal'Dazar on Heroic difficulty or higher.
Heritage of the Bronzebeard is the heritage armor set for the dwarf race.
The Heritage of the Sin'dorei is the heritage armor set for the blood elf race. Unlike other sets, it includes two chest pieces allowing a choice between a robe and pants.
The Heritage of Kul Tiras is the heritage armor set for the Kul Tiran allied race.

Heroes Through Time was a battleground that was never released. It was scrapped during early development of Warlords of Draenor as it never reached a point that Blizzard deemed satisfactory. It was presumably scrapped to focus the efforts on Ashran.
Hermetic Seaslugs are snails located in Nazmir and Zuldazar.
The Heritage of the Shu'halo is the heritage armor set for the tauren race.
The Heritage of Gnomeregan is the heritage armor set for the gnome race. Canonically, the set is the official uniform for members of the Gnomish Elite Aerial Rangers (G.E.A.R.).
__NOTOC__ Heretical Warmothers are blood dire trolls located in Nazmir.

The following is a list of non-pet Ally cards included in the Heroes of Azeroth set. This is intended as a quick reference to show which characters (or character artwork) have been utilized elsewhere in the Warcraft franchise, as well as a quick display of other key details.
The Heritage of Kezan is the heritage armor set for the goblin race.
The Heritage of Gilneas is the heritage armor set for the worgen race.
The Heritage of the Vulpera is the heritage armor set for the vulpera race.
The Heritage of the Mechagnome is the heritage armor set for the mechagnome race.
Herme the Wise is a deceased vrykul located in Beryl Meadow in Stormsong Valley, having been killed by Severus the Outcast.
The Hermit's Hood drops from Hermit Palefur in the Howling Crag in the Spires of Arak.

Herculon is a centurion located in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion. Surrounding the centurion is four Anima Conduits. Each conduit must be charged with three Weak Anima Mote for Herculon to activate. Once defeated, Herculon will leave behind an Aspirant's Chest.

Heritage of the Kul Tirans is a reputation achievement earned for leveling a Kul Tiran character to 50 without the use of Recruit-A-Friend level grants or the Character Boost, Race Change, or Faction Change services.
Hero's Call: Nagrand! may refer to: *Hero's Call: Nagrand! (Outland) *Hero's Call: Nagrand! (Draenor)
Hermestes is an Ascended kyrian located at the Eternal Watch in Bastion.
Herbalist's Pouches are looted from Village Strongboxes and Secret Treasures in Revendreth.
Herbert's Spell Book can be found in the lake east of the Ogre Ruins on Exile's Reach. It belongs to Herbert Gloomburst and includes details on how to cast Polymorph. __NOTOC__
Here's an Axe, Get to Work! is a potential quest of the Necrolord Assault on Perdition Hold.
Hero's Enchanting Cache is rewarded from the following missions: *Brittlebark Manifestations *Dangerous Harvest *Dreaded Lukir *The Necrotic Wake (adventure)
Hero's Herbalism Cache is obtained from the following missions: *Brittlebark Manifestations *The Necrotic Wake (adventure) *Dreaded Lukir *Dangerous Harvest
Hero's Mining Cache is obtained from the following missions: *Brittlebark Manifestations *The Necrotic Wake (adventure) *Dreaded Lukir *Dangerous Harvest
Hero's Skinning Cache is obtained from the following missions: *Brittlebark Manifestations *The Necrotic Wake (adventure) *Dreaded Lukir *Dangerous Harvest
Hero's Tailoring Cache is obtained from the following missions: *Brittlebark Manifestations *The Necrotic Wake (adventure) *Dreaded Lukir *Dangerous Harvest
Hero's Meat Cache is a reward from the following adventures: *Cleaning Gone Wrong *Cloudfeather Guardian (adventure) *Lady Ouix'Ara (adventure) *Sinstone Hoarder (adventure)
Hero's Fish Cache is a reward from the following adventures: *Cleaning Gone Wrong *Cloudfeather Guardian (adventure) *Lady Ouix'Ara (adventure) *Sinstone Hoarder (adventure)
Heroic: Algeth'ar Academy is a dungeon & raid achievement earned by defeating the Echo of Doragosa in Algeth'ar Academy on Heroic difficulty or higher.

__NOTOC__ Herbalist Agura is a centaur located at his tent in western Teerakai in the Ohn'ahran Plains. As part of Khansguard Jebotai's war orders, he tells Agura to expect to treat wounded soldiers. This saddens Agura, as he prefers the peaceful scent of flowers over war.
Herbed Turtle Meat is provided as an objective for Food or Floof.
